readerCopy.body: The person making the move faces the person who can block access, funding, or permission with a single decision. One side points to urgency and the right to act; the other points to ownership, consequence, and the power to make resistance expensive. Mars gives the challenge force, while Pluto concentrates the leverage that can absorb or crush it. The opposition places open action directly across from private control. A winner may emerge, but the contest reveals whether future cooperation will be possible without one side accepting submission.
